text:
Kara: Quick sync  want a compact launch for a new OSS repo `devflow-starter`: 1) micro tutorial blog, 2) 30m live build-along, 3) a tiny reproducible bench. Goal: contributors + signups. Thoughts?

Ben: Good. Keep the code minimal: one `start.sh` and a single `bench/quick.py`. Make CPU-only runnable.

Rox: Webinar format: 5m intro, 15m build-along, 5m bench demo, 5m Q&A. Show how to run the perf badge in 2 commands.

Ivy: Registration: HubSpot form `hs_devflow_2026`. Add hidden utm `devflow_launch`. Route enterprise interest to AE if checkbox `enterprise` is checked.

Kara: Copy idea for blog lead: "Devflow-starter: a one-command starter to run inference locally and measure perf." Short and scannable.

Ben: I'll open the PR tonight with `start.sh` and `bench/quick.py`. Small README with this snippet:
```
# run workshop
bash start.sh --local
python bench/quick.py --tokens 64
```

Rox: Marketing assets: need a tiny PNG from bench (p95 snapshot). Ben can dump `bench/out.png`. I'll make a gif later.

Ivy: Routing snippet for infra (very small):
```
{ "form_id":"hs_devflow_2026", "fields":{"email":"email","enterprise":"enterprise"}, "routing":{"enterprise":"AE_QUEUE","else":"DEVREL"} }
```

Ben: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devflow-starter/pull/3  includes quickstart + bench. Tagging @Rox.

Rox: I'll draft the short blog and the webinar runbook. Can Growth set a 3-email drip for registrants? @growth-bot

growth-bot: Confirmed: 3-email drip template created `drip_devflow_3`.

Kara: Owners: code -> Ben; blog + bench narrative -> Rox; HS form + routing -> Ivy; webinar -> Kara + Rox.

Ben: Bench sample: p50=70ms p95=210ms (local quant, batch=4). Pushing png now.

Rox: Great  aim to publish Mon and run webinar Wed. Rehearsal Tue 10am.

Ivy: HS form live and webhook set to only notify #sales when `enterprise=true`.

Kara: Thanks team. Post rehearsal I'll drop the final links here and we can publish. :raised_hands:
